newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DCP sells Sky City stake for NZ$18.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: DCP sells Sky City stake for NZ$18.2 mln.

text.p: Investment company Direct Capital Partners Ltd said on Friday it had sold its entire holding of 504,650 shares in Sky City.
"Direct Capital Partners initially invested NZ$12.1 million in Sky City prior to Sky City's stock exchange listing and has realised $18.2 million," DCP said in a statement.
"The realised gain of $6.1 million represents a 71 percent cash on cash return to Direct Captial."
The company's primary focus is to invest in unlisted companies, and it said it was currently considering further investments.
DCP said it expected to announce its result for the year ended June 30, 1997, in early September.
